# Base44 Expert

> Independent specialist studio that unsticks stuck Base44 apps.
> English studio brand — not a personal-name agency. Not affiliated with Base44 / Wix.

## Who we are
- Studio site: https://base44expert.com
- Contact: mailto:na0ryank0@gmail.com
- Related tool: https://fixthebase.com
- Footer credit may include “Built by Naor Yanko”; public face is the studio.

## What we unstick
- Publish said success but live URL unchanged / publish failures
- Custom domain DNS, pending SSL, Cloudflare proxy issues
- Entity schema mismatches and missing records
- Preview works, production breaks (env, connectors, assets)
- Blank screen / stuck thinking after a change — after checking https://status.base44.com

## What we don’t do
- Greenfield app builds from scratch as a productized service
- Fake testimonials, invented metrics, or client logos
- Official Base44 support (link users to docs and status when appropriate)
